## Summary

Describe the change and link the related issue.

## Validation

List commands/results and any skipped or unvalidated live integrations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused change; unrelated worktree changes excluded
- [ ] Tests and relevant documentation updated
- [ ] No secrets, private meeting data or real credentials in code/artifacts
- [ ] Tenant/access checks and provider agnosticism preserved
- [ ] Migration, backup and deployment implications documented if applicable
- [ ] Third-party licenses/notices preserved and new material attributed
- [ ] UI accessibility/responsiveness checked if applicable
